details: Membership queries can eliminate at least one remaining candidate concept at each nonterminal step.
proof: For any finite projection $\mathcal{G}$ of $\mathcal{H}$, repeatedly choose a coordinate on which two remaining concepts disagree.  The answer eliminates at least one candidate, so at most $|\mathcal{G}|-1\le |\mathcal{H}|-1$ queries suffice.  Hence $\mathrm{Q}_m^p(\mathcal{H})\le |\mathcal{H}|$.
name: Size / Projected Membership Queries Complexity
